content.title: Shineco executives launch up to $2M open-market stock purchase program
content.summary: Shineco (SISI) announced that Ms. Jennifer Zhan, the CEO, and Mr. Sam Wang, the Company’s CFO, will jointly initiate a stock purchase program to purchase up to $2,000,000 of the Company’s common stock, par value $0.001 per share at a price of up to $1.50 per share, reflecting their strong beliefs that the Common Stock is undervalued.
